_source: Casa Monarch upper floor under the gable roof (ridge along x at y = 4.25, 7.5 m above the ground floor). Cathedral ceilings: the roof lining is the ceiling, walls across the slope get a profile-wall infill.

exterior_walls._comment: Eaves walls are 15 cm taller than the storey so their top disappears inside the roof build-up.

interior_walls._comment: East wall of bedroom and guest room; PW_UF_WEST_E continues it up to the roof.
Parallel to the ridge, so a flat top 1 cm inside the roof lining is enough.

profile_walls._comment: Pentagon between the eaves walls, 2 cm into the roof so no sliver of sky shows.
